expression: (http.host eq "law.viento.me" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/proposals" "/crawling-transparency" "/announcements" "/webhook" "/license"} or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/announcements/") and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/__data.json")) or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/notices/*" and not http.request.uri.path wildcard "/notices/*/*" and not http.request.uri.path in {"/notices/changes" "/notices/semantic-search"}) or http.request.uri.path wildcard "/notices/*/og.png" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "/api/notices/*/screenshot")) and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/__data.json") and http.response.code eq 200 and not any(http.response.headers["set-cookie"][*] ne "")
purpose: Restoration reference captured before the requested migration to a regular Cache Rule.
